top_signals.title: The Entrepreneurs Behind Poppi Start Over
top_signals.summary: Poppi founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth tell Bloomberg This Weekend how they turned a farmers market business into a nearly $2 billion beverage brand and what they learned from the decade-long journey. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, the couple explains why they are starting over with Jetty, a new hydration brand, and how lessons about social media, hiring and building a team are shaping their second act. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
